body:
## What
- `hkb watch [--interval 30] [--kinds completed,blocked,...]` prints one line per board transition (status label changes, new attempts, outcomes) by polling with `If-None-Match` ETags so unchanged polls cost no rate limit (304).
- `hkb tail <n>` follows one task's attempts and comments the same way.
- Put the loop in `src/watch.js`; `cli.js` only routes. `--json` emits one JSON object per line.

## Done when
Both commands run against this repo and a 304 poll is observable in `GHK_DEBUG=1` output.
title: hkb watch / hkb tail: live board and task events with conditional requests
